docs.description: Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK) announced today management’s participation in the following upcoming investor conferences
title: Sandisk Announces Participation in Investor Conferences

docs.description: Sandisk today introduced the SANDISK® iNAND® CL EM181 Embedded Flash Drive (EFD) at electronica 2026, expanding its portfolio of embedded flash solutions for the physical AI and Internet of Things (IoT) markets.
title: Sandisk Expands IoT Portfolio with New SANDISK® iNAND® CL EM181 Embedded Flash Drive at electronica 2026

docs.description: "We have started fiscal year 2027 with another quarter of strong performance, with robust and growing demand for our products driving outpaced growth in our data center business."
title: Sandisk Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results

docs.description: Sandisk today announced its partnership with Meta to be the exclusive provider of next-generation flash storage solutions for Meta VR Glasses when they launch in Spring 2027.
title: Sandisk Named Exclusive Storage Partner for Meta VR Glasses
